summary: Central Puerto S.A. disclosed via a US-equivalent Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) that it and wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired their own shares under Argentina's Capital Markets Law buyback regime. On 2026-10-01, CPSA bought 100,000 BYMA-listed shares at AR$1,914.38 each (AR$191,438,765) and Proener bought 20,000 NYSE ADRs at US$11.87 (US$237,405.02), settling 2026-10-02. Same-day purchases stayed under 25% of the trailing ninety-business-day average daily volume; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or overhang mechanics were stated.
